steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: After all that trouble, the information from this cipher machine turns out to be nothing but gossip. Who in the world would collect intelligence like this...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Could it be... the owner of this machine is actually a tabloid journalist? But who...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Young adventurer Christina! The legendary sword you requested is complete! Hand over that cipher machine in exchange!

Mess suddenly materializes before Christina. In her left hand, she wields a foam sword studded with light strips that pulse with dazzling rainbow colors. In her right, a speaker blasts her powerful entrance music.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Mess... Why are you here? I never asked you to forge a sword. Detectives don't even use swords...

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: And besides, that thing in your hand...

steps.speaker: Mess
steps.content: Cut the chatter and hand it over!

Whap! The foam sword lands with perfect precision on Christina's head, the impact as crisp as a ping-pong ball. As Christina clutches the stinging spot, Mess's hand darts past her to snatch the cipher machine.
But the sting is fleeting. The young detective shakes it off, tightens her grip on the device, and breaks into a sprint once more.

steps.speaker: Christina
steps.content: Not a chance! This cipher machine absolutely cannot fall into your hands!
